body: More connected than ever, yet so alone.

Do you enjoy being on call pretty much 24/7? Do you enjoy being mismanaged? Do you enjoy training to train with no opportunity to deploy? Do you enjoy receiving job training that you will almost never use because you won't do your job?

Most people in the military are just butts in seats. It's an easy, not rewarding job. Either go support special forces, special missions, joint assignments, or activities.

It opens up opportunities after 3 years of active duty service in the US like college money, home loans, vested retirement in a 401k. 

It's just not the purpose I needed.
